गौण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
 1. Having qualities or attributes.
 2. Relating to
multiplication or enumeration.
 3. Secondary, subordinate.
 4.
Secondery as applied to the month, reckoned from full-moon to
full-moon.
 E. गुण, and अण् aff. गुणमधिकृत्य प्रवृत्ता गौणी ततः आगतः अण् ।

गौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having qualities, relating to or connected with
them.
 E. गुण, and ठक् aff. गुणे रूपादौ साधुः ।
